schema.name: TelemetryFrame
schema.doc: Canonical 64-byte payload schema used across all managed backends for parity fixtures. Designed as the payload of a triad-1 envelope (bind at envelope.headerSize). Every numeric field is naturally aligned; all values in golden fixtures are exactly representable (dyadic) so cross-language comparisons are bit-exact.

fields.name: schemaId
fields.doc: Payload schema handshake; checked by validateHeader() before any field read (Law 4).

fields.name: velocity
fields.doc: Velocity vector, m/s. Maps to SIMD3<Float> / vector_float3 on Apple platforms.

fields.name: reserved
fields.doc: Reserved; must be zero. Excluded from fluent setters.
